# netbox_cable (Data Source)

Retrieves a single cable from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_cable" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "cable_id" {
  value = data.netbox_cable.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bundle_id` (Number) The ID of the bundle associated with the cable.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the cable.
- `label` (String) The label of the cable.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the cable.
- `profile` (String) The profile of the cable.
- `status` (String) The status of the cable.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the cable.
- `type` (String) The type of the cable.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) The color of the cable.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the cable.
- `created` (String) The created of the cable.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the cable, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the cable.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the cable.
- `length` (Number) The length of the cable.
- `length_unit` (String) The length unit of the cable.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
